subject: general
question: Who led the railway strike in 1974?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1974**__.

__
 
• **George Fernandes led the railway strike in 1974.**__​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **George Mathew Fernandes** was an** Indian trade unionist, statesman, Journalist.**
 
• He was **born on 3 June 1930.**
 
• He was a former member of the **Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha.**
 
• All India **Railway strike of 1974** was the most notable strike organized by Fernandes when he was the president of All India Railwaymen's Federation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
